    Reorienting a quiver #

    Reo V fl has the vertices of V and reverses the arrows a ⟶ b with fl a b. It has the same underlying graph, so Gabriel's theorem for Euclidean trees applies to every orientation (RayCat.Reo.not_isRepresentationFinite_affineD).
